#C236196003Sakura#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF now.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF.

Apocalypse Now!
Come back soooooooon!

Surely you aren't thinking of WALKING back?
Do you intend to make me march for no purpose?
Look for that #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF!

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF is right.
Let's head back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest.

Obtained

Obtained
Checkpoint unlocked.
Stay here.

Let's play hide-and-seek, okay?
You'll be it first!
Could she be another Master brought here by BB…?
…we infiltrate the seventh floor of the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF.
*kgh*… no problems here.

The mental image density here is several times
higher than before, but thanks to #C236196003Rin#CDEF and #C236196003Rani#CDEF,
position capturing is stable.
Please focus on ensuring #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF's safety.

Contrary to its capacity, the sonar's response
is sort of dull… It's like, tremendously
heavy…

Heavy?
Are you saying it has high capacity?

Not that it's heavy.
The processing isn't heavy,
it's physically heavy… more like.
Pressurized data…?

Data gets compressed in order to free up
memory or to speed up transmissions…
Maybe this is the compressed data.
Ergh!?
Sorry, Master.

Eh? Is that sugar candy looking thing
really that heavy?
Even #C236196003#SVT#CDEF couldn't lift up this mass.

………address, parsed.
Download time remaining―――
10 minutes?

………………………umm.
…that's something I threw away.
…do you… like collecting trash…?

Her intent to assail us is nonexistent.
Her docile countenance makes me think
she's not an enemy.
The girl stares at us silently.
Bigger doesn't always mean betttteeerrr!

Damn this Oppai Monster!
That emphasized bust is a declaration of war
upon all women…!
The #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF stares at us in silence.

She may be observing us in preparation for a fight
for all we know.
I should―――
Fight and buy time somehow!

Eh? Fight…?
I'm sorry… I'm a little tired right now, so…

I won't fight.
Please do the same, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.
Um… I'm sorry for being so selfish…
Ah, she up and apologized…
…may I, introduce myself?
…uhh.
Reply, "You don't deserve my name."

…ah…
P-pleasure to, meet you…!
All the more if it's an offshoot of #C236196003BB#CDEF.

………I-I'm sorry….
I said something weird, despite being
your enemy…

…so… please,
don't come and attack me from now on.
#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF vanished.

? My ears maaaay have tingled a bit…
I have a bad feeling.

Ah! Found you, big #[brother][sister]#!
I need to hide, I need to hurry and hide!

So it's THAT girl. Let's pursue, Master!
…hmhmhm. It looks like one punishment
wasn't enough for her!

That was… #C236196003Caster#CDEF?
She didn't seem hostile at all…

So it WAS that little brat!
Darling, hurry up!

If I find her, I won't hold back!
This time I'll glue that cheeky mouth
of hers shut!

A soul etched into the internet,
a type of ghost, I would say.

Hm? It feels like she ran on something
strange…

Huh? You got here already?
Umm… we're playing hide-and-seek,
not tag, though…

There's a huge lady up ahead.
Let's all go there and tease her!
The girl glides through a secret passage.
But… "huge lady"? That couldn't be…

…things sure just got heavy here in the
Arena…

Grr. Though I wish I could roast that little
brat over a fire, I don't think I can just
overlook her getting killed helplessly.

Let's hurry and catch up to her, #RUBS Darling#RUBEMaster#REND.
As a fellow#RUBSGlass Cannon#RUBE Caster#REND, I can't NOT help.

Found them…!
The girl from before and the
#C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF: #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF…!

#C236196003Lip#CDEF is sitting, she still isn't attacking the girl.
We need to save the girl while she's unharmed―――
hey, wait a second.

Sto… Please stop…
Why aren't you listening to me…?

Huh? THAT'S why you called #RUBS   me#RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND? Unbelievable.
You really are slow in the head, too.

I-in the head, too…?
I-I've never been slow or anything like…

Mash! Crash! Only trash!
You're not a Queen's knight.
You're a doozy of an ugly, mammoth rook!

……#C236196003M-Melt#CDEF is way too thin, that's all she is.
I'm normal, I say.

Huh? Come on, #RUBS   me  #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND. You're still here?
If you keep dawdling, big #[brother][sister]# will…

Found you, #C236196003Lip#CDEF♪
Perfect timing.
I just picked up a useless rock.
Kya…! S-sto….!

Ahaha! That looks funny!
#RUBS I#RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND will throw in an old dress, then!
…it certainly was a bizarre scene.

The two girls parted #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's chest
and stuffed an item in forcefully.

Senpai… #C236196003#NICK#CDEF and #C236196003#SVT#CDEF are terribly
weak… If they attack me, every Labyrinth
will go to waste…

Senpai… #C236196003#NICK#CDEF and #C236196003#SVT#CDEF are
terribly… weak… If they attack me, every
Labyrinth will go to waste…

Senpai… #C236196003#NICK#CDEF and #C236196003#SVT#CDEF are
terribly… weak… If they attack me, every
Labyrinth will go to waste…

Senpai… #C236196003#NICK#CDEF and #C236196003#SVT#CDEF are
terribly… weak… If they attack me, every
Labyrinth will go to waste…

A monster like you looks good with your
head hanging down.

Fatty, fatty♪
#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF is a fatty♪

Ah, ooohh…
Stop… Please, stop…
I haven't done anything wrong, though…
Should we just leave her like this?
I call out, "Wait."
As a rule, you mustn't go picking on turtles.

Oh? Big #[brother][sister]#?
Could it be that #C120200255Alice#CDEF was finally caught?

Ah, big #[brother][sister]#! Yoo-hoo!
I've been waiting for you!
Let's tease #C236196003Lip#CDEF together!

Maybe they were Servants revived by #C236196003BB#CDEF,
like with the #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF―――
………, come again?
Save? I? Her?

U-umm….
Thank you, very much…
I'm happy… so very happy…
―――I was too late.

#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF, who had broken down crying,
courageously stands up and stares at us.

…her eyes are damp from the girls making
her cry just now… is what I'm hoping.

Senpai―――#C236196003#NICK#CDEF,
do you want to be crushed between…?
Try to if you can!

…is it really, alright?
I'm, err…
Really happy, but…

Once you go through it once, you can never
come back… Do you still want to be put
between my…?
…between where?

…I understand… I'll do my best not to
hurt you. I'll be careful…
Ready―――

―――Please become a cube,
through and through.

Did, something, happen?
After #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF lifted me, suddenly,
my vision, closed shut.
No―――
I have vision.
I never knew such mortal suffering existed in this universe.

…it's alright, because, you're alive…
I'll keep you like this in my cleavage,
forever and ever.
―――Those were the last words I ever heard.
Unable to move my limbs or my head in the slightest,

I, formerly #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF,
was discarded into oblivion.
My gaze, being that head-on, is averted.

While #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's arms and legs squirm,
she incoherently replies in embarrassment.

Eh… I, I said…
Umm… my…
my… you know…
My?

I press on relentlessly, asking just
what on Earth with and how?

I-I'm saying…
Umm… my…

My interest in #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's structure is
purely academic and practical.

Why and what will she crush?
Say it loud and proud, #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF!

O-okayyyy…!
U-umm, in my…
there's a secret…!

I'm sorry―――as long as it's compressed data,
there's a recycle bin in here that
can store anything…!
#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF confesses, face flushed red.

Eh―――
B-burning… I'm, burning up…
This… ahh… I can't…
A secret related to that chest.

#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF―――That titanic chest itself
is one of her mind-exposing secrets…!

………………
That was… a gap in my mind…
My… #C000246204SG#CDEF…
#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF looks at us, dazed.

Like #C236196003Kiara#CDEF said, an #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF's
"gaps of the mind" manifest easily.
―――She won't fight!?

…Senpai.
Thank you very much
for protecting me back there.
In any case, job well done, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.

#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.
I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

We found a fragment of "something"
embedded into the ground.

It's about five centimeters in size;
a lump in the shape of a cube.
In any case, when I tried to pick it up―――

What's up with this ridiculous weight!?
There's no way I can lift it with my strength…!

Then allow me. We're not majestically wielding
a longsword here. Look, do it as if picking up
a single berry from some grapes…

Goodness gracious. Out of the way.
Just looking at it, I don't think it has THAT
much informati…………

Hmm… If Darling can't do it,
I won't be able to either.

Ahaha! You can't even lift a folder that size?
You've reached your very lowest, mongrel!
Here, I'll take th―――
What did you say?

Contrary to how this cube looks, it seems to
be a compressed object of very intricate
and highly dense data.
It's impossible to retrieve it with just us.

Then we'll switch over to retrieving it
through copying. Please place your hand on
that cube.

…hold on. Although borrowed, we're using 
pseudo-Spiritron circuits here, you know?
How can it take 10 minutes, what sort of――
At that moment.

A jolt like an amped current ran up my spine.
I felt an intense apprehension,
or perhaps pressure.

This presence is unlike #C236196003BB#CDEF's.
This bizarre oppression―――
It's an #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF!

That thing in the shape of a young girl
was a natural mass of discomfort.
This girl has no bloodlust or hostility.

However―――Her entire peaceful impression
is negated by those fiendish claws…!

#C000246204Alter Egos#CDEF are parts of #C236196003BB#CDEF,
and #C236196003BB#CDEF is of the same model as #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.

It makes sense that this girl's appearance
resembles #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.

However, this girl's disposition seems to be
different than #C236196003Sakura#CDEF or #C236196003BB#CDEF's.

Compared to the high-tension #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF,
she has an air of meekness, a real downer―――

Nevertheless, those are some dreadful,
dangerous weapons. Indescribable.
Totally indescribable.

…however, she's got some terrifying, lethal
weapons. What do you think, Master?

I-I can tell from a glance that she's evil,
Darling! She's making a show of flaunting those
outrageous, deadly weapons!

…I'm getting nauseous.
What hideous, fiendish weapons.
Mongrel. What are your thoughts?
Yeah, those claws are crazy.
Yeah, that chest is crazy.
…which ones are the deadly weapons?

Yes, a single one of those claws is fit to be a
Servant's weapons. But close-quarters combat is
my domain. I'll show my superb skills here!

Yeah. A single straight blow from those
and we'll definitely end up with a mortal wound.
Stay on your toes.

I'm kiiinnddaa not that great at fighting
close up. I think I'd prefer to do my best at
prickling her down with curses!

Are you seriously saying THAT? Her claws aren't
what you should be looking at! I'm talking about
something with more RAW desire!

Umu! She's a disgrace of an enemy. However――
the truth is that she's worthy of admiration,
despite being disgraceful. Big is good!

Although, that doesn't mean she's perfect.
Overwhelming power cannot reach small places.
Balance in everything, Praetor.

…I'm talking about her claws.
What are YOU talking about?

I was talking about her claws―――
―――Ohh, I get it. I'm being rude,
I didn't give them any thought yet.

Indeed, indeed. Even I, who have loved
beautiful women across all places
past and present cannot conceal my shock.

Buxom women aren't in my taste, but THAT there
makes the collector in me tingle in excitement.
In any case, reaching new heights is good!

Those colossal claws and breasts, see!
Yes, they're both so grand!
Just the way I like it!

Those claws, of course.
They must have a considerable striking range.

O-O-O-O-OBVIOUSLY the claws!
I don't give a single damn about that chest
at all! It's big, but that's it!

Of course, those twin clumps―like devils!
They're not to my taste, but anything
THAT majestic is. They're worth mocking.

…there's a little less than 8 minutes left
until #C236196003Rani#CDEF's data duplication finishes…

She looks fiendish, but isn't aggressive.
We could probably win if we fought her,
but it's risky.
Wait and see what happens.
We'll fight, knowing it's dangerous.

I'm also worried about dust messing with the
data duplication midway, but more importantly,
this is a chance to gauge this #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF's strength…!

I reflexively stop and stare back at the #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF.
Her unexpected statement that she "won't fight"
dampened my own eagerness to fight…

Our enemy is an #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF, who we know nothing
about.

It's too early to be picking a fight.
Though I know it's an unreasonable wish,
we need to keep playing cool somehow until she leaves.

But how long we can really keep
her at bay with a standoff…!?
Is she coming……!?

I said, "Go ahead" without thinking.
Her well-mannered request was
unlike anything I'd expect from a part of #C236196003BB#CDEF.

……my name is…… #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF.
Please feel free to call me that,
it would make me happy.

#C236196003Passionlip#CDEF.
It sounds like that's this #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF's personal name.
In response, I―――
Reply, "Nice to meet you, Lip."
Introduce myself.

Regardless of who she is,
she introduced herself courteously.
I casually reply, "Nice to meet you, #C236196003Lip#CDEF."
Enemies are undeserving of my name.

Even though she's our enemy, if one
gives their name, you give your name back.
It's basic courtesy.

While holding the impatient #C236196003#SVT#CDEF back with a
raised hand, I introduce my Servant and I
with our names.

I-I know already…
Since, I… have always been watching you
since the first layer…

…but, um.
Since I'm the guardian of this layer,
that makes me everyone's enemy.

Since Mother… that woman ordered me to,
I have to fight anyone who tries to pass
through the Labyrinth…

I-if you ever have time to spare,
you can always, umm―――

…no, nevermind. If you're fine with such
trash, you can do with it as you like, so…

……erm.
No matter how much I hold back, I won't be able
to rescue you, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF…

The impression her name gives seems to be
at odds with her disposition,
but there's no doubt that she's made from #C236196003BB#CDEF.
I think it's best to consider her our enemy.

Download complete. We'll decompress
the contents, so please return to base
for now, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.

We only just entered the Labyrinth,
but I'm curious about that unknown, compressed data.

For the time being,
let's head back to the Student Council Room.
―――Was someone on the path ahead of us?

That white sundress…
It's sort of familiar, but I can't really remember…

An acquaintance of yours?
It appears to be a Master from the
Near Side… an ethereal one.

…hmph. I had no interest in it up until now,
but your battles in the Near Side must have
been quite fascinating.

Anyway, after her, Master!
We have to teach her how terrifying
adults can be!

Footholds we can't see, huh…
It looks like she's got a terrain
advantage over us.

But she hasn't widened the distance yet.
Let's go after her, Master!

Oh dear. It looks like there are hidden paths.
Typical child, she went and exposed
the secret herself.

Now then, let's head off, Darling. We were lucky
to run into her here. We can't let the number of
Casters increase any more than this!

This… doesn't appear to be her special skill.
There seems to be openings in this structure.

Try stepping over them as well, mongrel.
If we don't hasten, this ghost may slip
through our fingers, you know?

Well, that's a-okay!
Just chase me this way!
There's fun to be had over here!

That adjective applies to only one person.
Praetor. I'm sorry to say this, but the
fun and games end here.

If we don't hurry, that little girl will be
ripped to pieces by that #C000246204Alter Ego#CDEF's claws.
Ready, Master? This fight is going to be nasty.

It must be no other than that #C000246204Ego#CDEF.
We have just the right bait to test her
brutality against.

We must hasten and pursue her. #C000246204Ego#CDEF and ghost.
If things go well, will we see them
destroy one another?
…this feels very much different than what I imagined.

Why listen to you? #ROFS-003#RUBS   I'm  #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF is#REND #RUBS    my #RUBE#C120200255Alice#CDEF's#REND Servant.
#ROFS0017#RUBSI#RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF#REND won't listen to the Queen's orders.

#RUBS     I'm    #RUBE#C255045045Alice#CDEF is#REND in the middle of a stroll through
the park. Don't be a bother during fun time.
Why not go exterminate the pests on your own?

But… I can't really run very much… since this
floor is so cramped. I soon got stuck in a
wall, so I called you both here. Yet…

…this is very unlike what we're used to
seeing. Maybe we should wait a bit longer
and see what happens.

…that's… her ally, I guess? Nevertheless,
this is dangerous. Let's stay planted here
a little longer, Master.

Huh? Is it just me or have the #ROFS0001#RUBS Seme#RUBEtop#REND and #RUBS   Uke#RUBEbottom#REND 
switched positions?
…hmm. Let's watch for now, #RUBS  Master#RUBEDarling#REND.

…an unexpected turn of events.
A monster with such weaponry being driven
back by a little girl?
…it IS a strange situation.

That girl in black is a different person from
the one we saw on the path, and tears are welling up
in #C236196003Passionlip#CDEF's eyes.

Fortunately, they don't seem to notice us yet,
so let's stay here and keep watching.

Slow. Compared to #C236196003Melt#CDEF, you look
like you're standing still.

And just WHAT is with that gross meat on you?
Even the #C000246204Jabberwocky#CDEF would pass on a meal
as big as you.

Ever looked in a mirror?
What part of you is normal―――

I don't want to just throw it out,
so I'll give it you, #C236196003Lip#CDEF. Okay, here you go.

I-it won't fit! Please don't stretch out my
chest…! Please don't cram in data that big…!
